summary.text: Phoenix K. Altair of Irasburg, an independent, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Vermont's at-large U.S. House seat to Becca Balint.
Altair received 0.8% of the vote to Becca Balint's 65.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
No biography or campaign statements were found on Ballotpedia, and Altair did not respond to Vermont Public's candidate survey.
